verdict.rationale: Speechmatics offers a web platform for building voice AI agents, so letting those agents plug in MCP servers and use their tools is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP or connecting to external tool servers. Its Agent STT and agent-building features cover transcription for LLMs, not tool-server integration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
